explanation: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Lissa (1811)" (revision 1380913966) says: "A protégé of Horatio Nelson, Hoste recalled the inspirational effect of Nelson's signal before the Battle of Trafalgar and raised his own: "Remember Nelson", which was greeted with wild cheering from the British squadron." The edge reads that sentence as: Battle of Trafalgar inspired Battle of Lissa (1811), and nothing more.
